### Who is Privileged? - Truth For Life - June 24
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-june-24-2019.html
Passage: Luke 11:27-28
Points:
- Many mistakenly assume Mary enjoyed an exclusive intimacy with Christ unavailable to anyone else.
- Scripture indicates Mary did not possess spiritual knowledge beyond what other disciples could receive.
- Jesus treats all faithful followers as intimate friends, making the Father's will known to them.
- Any believer who hears and obeys God's Word shares genuine communion with Christ.
